newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zellweger initials deal to sell Burkhalter.
newsitem.headline: Zellweger initials deal to sell Burkhalter.

text.p: Zellweger Luwa said it had agreed in principle to sell its Burkhalter division to an unidentified group of investors, but it gave no more details.

"Regarding the intention announced on April 16 to divest the Burkhalter division, the annual shareholders meeting was informed that an agreement in principle on a sale was recently signed with a group of investors," it said in a statement.
"Due-diligence investigations will begin in the next few days. Details will be announced in due course."
The installations and network technology division had 1996 sales of 230.1 million Swiss francs. -- Zurich +41 1 631 7340
